mapper.insert: INSERT INTO judge_cache (cache_key, output, rubric_id, hit_count, update_time) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{output}, #{rubricId}, 0, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE output = VALUES(output), hit_count = 0, update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO judge_cache (cache_key, output, rubric_id, hit_count, update_time) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{output}, #{rubricId}, 0, #{updateTime}) ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET output = EXCLUDED.output, hit_count = 0, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT id, cache_key, output, rubric_id, hit_count, update_time FROM judge_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE judge_cache SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey}
